title: PA measles outbreak tops 1,000 cases, largest since disease was eliminated
gist: Pennsylvania's measles outbreak has reached 1,078 cases for 2026, the largest since elimination in 2000 and since 1991, with 207 hospitalizations and five deaths. Nationally the CDC counts 3,887 cases, PAHO is expected to strip US elimination status in November, and New York declared a disaster emergency.

insights.claim: Pennsylvania's measles outbreak, with 1,078 cases in 2026 (1,066 since April), is the largest in the US since measles was declared eliminated in 2000 and the largest on record since 1991.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: The record outbreak shows elimination-era assumptions failing.

insights.claim: The outbreak has produced 207 hospitalizations and five deaths, including two infants too young to vaccinate; all deaths were unvaccinated people.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Severity data underlines the human cost of falling vaccination coverage.

insights.claim: With 145 cases in the last seven days and 34 new infections since Monday, the outbreak does not appear close to ending.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Continuing transmission implies further growth in the tally.
insights.locator: With 34 new infections reported since Monday

insights.claim: Pennsylvania's 1,066 outbreak-linked cases exceed the previous record holder, South Carolina's 997-case outbreak that ended in April, and the 762-case Texas outbreak of 2025; only New York's 1990-1991 outbreak of over 4,500 was larger.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Each recent outbreak has set a new post-elimination record.

insights.claim: The CDC reports 3,887 measles cases nationwide this year, the highest since 1991's 9,643, and outbreaks are lasting into the fall when measles was historically a late winter and early spring virus.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
entities: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
insights.so_what: Off-season spread suggests conditions could accelerate transmission.

insights.claim: PAHO experts will review in November whether the US has lost measles elimination status, which experts widely expect; Canada lost its status in 2025.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Loss of elimination status would be a formal reversal of a 2000 public health milestone.
insights.locator: In November, experts at the Pan American Health Organization

insights.claim: Slipping vaccination rates nationwide are the driver of measles outbreaks coming roaring back in recent years.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Coverage gaps, not exotic causes, explain the resurgence.

insights.claim: New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a State Disaster Emergency over at least 108 measles cases, letting paramedics, advanced EMS, pharmacists and midwives vaccinate and nurses order measles tests.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Expanding the vaccinator workforce is the lever states are using to surge response.
insights.quote: No one should get seriously ill or die from a vaccine-preventable disease
